envios.prompt:
Exact first-person opening [1]: two hands beginning to unwrap an opaque patterned gift on the low coffee table. Keep the gift fully covered, its scale, finger contacts and camera angle. No revealed machine yet. Change sleeve knit to muted plum.

Only the source hand pose is compositional; use natural anonymous hands and no featured face in this opening.

Use the exact product or package reference for geometry, materials, markings and scale. Action props and concealed products remain in their stated opening state.

Use the actual living room [3]: large TV with blue winter scene on a white cabinet, small white decorative houses, tree on the left, curtains and matching floor. The viewer sits on a sofa opposite the TV; table immediately in front. Make the intended audience recognizable on first sight, without sound or captions. Use one prominent, physically plausible visual cue belonging to this product's audience in the described setting. Keep the action, hand positions and reveal timing intact.

Match the cool blue TV spill and subdued daylight of [3], warm tiny tree lights; hands, opaque gift paper and table share the same shadows and blue bounce. When a room, space or environment reference is supplied, its observed lighting is the primary authority for the entire scene, overriding conflicting lighting in composition, avatar, product or style references and generic lighting recipes. Match its light direction, sources, colour temperature, intensity, contrast, exposure and falloff across the person, skin, clothing, hands, product and packaging. Re-light inserted elements to that environment, including cast and contact shadows, occlusion, reflections and colour bounce; match perspective, scale, depth, sharpness and image texture. Preserve real differences between illuminated and shaded areas: coherent integration does not mean flat or evenly filled lighting. No pasted cutouts, halos, floating objects, isolated portrait lighting or independent exposure. If no environment reference is supplied, retain the scene-specific lighting described above.

Image 4 is realism reference only for texture. The scene-specific light in the previous paragraph controls all lighting; do not import the style photograph lighting or setting.  If an environment reference is supplied, this style reference supplies texture only and must not override that environment lighting.  Everyday phone-video softness varies with subject distance, light and movement; do not give skin, fabric and background identical fine detail. Do not copy its person, pose, face, clothing, product, logos or overlays. IDENTITY SOURCE PRIORITY: only the explicitly selected avatar references define each person. Ignore every face in realism/style references: never borrow or blend their facial geometry, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, age, hair or likeness. Apply photographic texture to the selected avatar without replacing or averaging that identity. Composition and background references also provide no identity unless explicitly assigned as an avatar. Preserve the identity and action already specified. No artificial HDR or cosmetic skin smoothing.

One coherent vertical 9:16 casual phone photograph with natural perspective and contact shadows.

No text overlays, captions, subtitles, emojis or interface. No watermark. Preserve physical product markings and shop signs.
